name: Labyrinth: Stars and Stone
source:
Astraia isn't entirely unfamiliar with feats of strength and heroism, but being sent to defeat a monster who turns people to stone might be a little over her head. Not because of the monster, really, but because she keeps running into women who make her heart pound—!

[From [url=https://toga-party.itch.io/labyrinth-stars-and-stone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿斯特莱亚并非完全不熟悉力量和英雄主义的壮举，但被派去打败一个把人变成石头的怪物可能有点难以理解。其实并不是因为怪物，而是因为她不断遇到让她心跳加速的女人——！

[来自[url=https://toga-party.itch.io/labyrinth-stars-and-stone]Itch.io[/url]]
